criteria.description: Unmodified closed outward geometry; actual transformed dimensions/counts, strict attachment and whole-scene exposure; source reopen; two distinct-PID semantic rebuilds; project/Khronos validation.

Personally inspect eight exact512px final frames plus lossless sheet; actual plate/ring relief must read, not only mesh loops or labels. Concept has overly vertical longitudinal bands and weak helical relief. Final makes true left-handed diagonal helical plate-row relief and full winding surface ambulacra, with two upper branches and one lower. Short basal cone only. Tiny pore stereom and tube feet omitted at lowpoly resolution, not replaced with invented spines.

Upright pear-spindle full-volume body with modest tapered basal cone, rounded upper pole and actual segmented LEFT-HANDED helical plate rows. Exactly three narrow surface ambulacral paths: two closely spaced upper branches and one lower branch meet at a lateral mouth. Lower branch ends above basal cone and upper pair below summit. No five-armed crown, apical mouth, stalk or long reconstruction support pole. Whole-organism stylized living reconstruction with pear/spindle theca, based on Sprinkle and Wilbur2005 fossil-cast photos and anatomical text. Fig1D is captioned H.everndeni LACMNH17529 under the older taxonomy, treated within revised H.gilberti per Wilbur2006 primary abstract. Full2006revision was not accessible. Mouth placement and pole organization follow2005interpretation; anus position is unresolved and is not invented. Nominal dimensions, colors and sampled plate counts are artistic.
